summary.text: Julia Howard is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 77 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The General Assembly lists her as serving her 19th House term, and her occupation as appraiser and realtor.

paragraphs.text: Howard has worked as an appraiser and realtor.
Ballotpedia lists her tenure in the North Carolina House as beginning in 1989, and the General Assembly's website lists her as representing Davie, Rowan and Yadkin counties.
In the 2025-2026 session Howard is senior chair of the Finance Committee and chair of the House Select Committee on Property Tax Reduction and Reform.

She is also a member of the Energy and Public Utilities, Insurance, and Judiciary 3 committees and co-chair of the Revenue Laws Study Committee and the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Unemployment Insurance.
